claims.source_quote_ar: إِذا دَعاكُمْ وحد الضمير كما وحده فيما قبله
claims.claim_ar: توحيد الضمير في خطاب الدعاء/النداء كوسيلة بلاغية للتوكيد والاحتواء — يُشبه توجيه النداء «يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا»؛ أي توجيهٍ يجمع المخاطبين ويشدّهم إلى الاستجابة.
claims.claim_en: The unification of the pronoun in the address (as in 'If He calls you...') is used as a rhetorical means of emphasis and inclusion — analogous to the vocative 'O you who believe', i.e. an address that gathers the addressees and urges response.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted chunk discusses the unified pronoun in a construction ('إِذا دعاكم ...') — applying this observation to the vocative formula of the ayah (يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا) is plausible but interpretive; source is Zamakhshari chunk rather than the other listed rhetoricians, so cross-check with Jurjani/Sakkaki/Baqillani/Suyuti is recommended.

claims.claim_ar: الإيجاز في لفظ «الفرقان»؛ كلمة موجزة ورمزية تحشد معانٍ متعددة (معيار/برهان/تمييز بين الحق والباطل) في لفظ واحد.
claims.claim_en: Conciseness (i'jaz) in the term 'al-Furqan'; a compact, symbolic word that gathers multiple meanings (criterion/evidence/distinction between truth and falsehood) in a single term.
claims.needs_review_reason: The chunk contains the lexeme 'الفرقان' (cf. discussion of 'يوم الفرقان'); claiming i'jaz for the Qur'anic use of 'فُرْقَان' is plausible but requires corroboration from classical balagha commentaries (Jurjani, Sakkaki, etc.) to confirm the rhetorical framing.

warnings: Provided source chunks are from Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf). The task requested extraction from al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, and tafsir-balagha materials; those specific sources were not present among the chunks. Claims therefore rely on the available Zamakhshari excerpts and may need verification against the requested authors.

Some claims generalize the chunk observations to the specific ayah (S8:A29). While the quoted substrings exist in the chunks, mapping their remark to this ayah is interpretive and should be reviewed by a specialist in classical balagha commentary.

Only substrings explicitly present in the provided chunks were used as source_quote_ar. If fuller or different source passages are intended, please supply the relevant balagha/tafsir chunks from the named authors for more precise, higher-confidence attributions.
